integrity: The algebraic proof and separate local symbolic checker are supplied. All review is same-model; no independent audit, external certification or experiment is represented.
scientific_limitations: Exact population moments only, with known trap relaxation and propulsion speed, strictly positive rates and no positional thermal diffusion. No finite-sample stability or priority certification; the marginal all-order moment formulas are previously published.
title: A sharp two-moment ambiguity and sixth-moment identifiability for trapped finite-tumble particles
